Rehabilitation of Road Infrastructure for Integration of the Territory

description.narrative: Continuar apoyando la recuperacin de la infraestructura vial en Hait, restableciendo las condiciones de operacin adecuadas, fomentando la prestacin de servicios de transporte terrestre en forma continua, competitiva y segura, lo cual permitir la reactivacin econmica y el mejoramiento de la calidad de vida de la poblacin.

Continue to contribute to the recovery of road infrastructure in Haiti, reestablishing adequate operating conditions, fostering continuous, competitive and safer transport services, and contributing to economic reactivation and improvement of the population's quality of life in the Southern part of the country.
